title: Covariant diffusion tensor for jet momentum broadening out of equilibrium
summary: Jets are produced in the earliest stages of heavy-ion collisions, where they can interact with a medium that is not yet close to local equilibrium. Motivated by this, we generalize the usual jet transport coefficient $\hat q$ to a Lorentz-covariant diffusion tensor $\hat q^{μν}$ within a leading-order elastic (Boltzmann/Fokker--Planck) description of jet--medium interactions.
